h:
• 完善的两阶段 SDXL 工作流程。只需单击一下，即可利用通配符生成真正无穷无尽的各种肖像。

  • 脆脆干净紧凑型布局！所有重要的事情都可以在一个屏幕上看到和访问。

  • RTX 4080 上的 21 秒升级输出。

  • 需要 FOCUS 节点。 （在 ComfyUI 管理器中可用）。通配符文件是内置的，随时可以使用。

  • 如果您不想浪费时间安装面部细节设置的要求，只需删除节点并在需要时重新附加链接即可。详细信息仅在使用特定检查点组合时才重要，并且对我的默认设置没有多大作用。

  • 带有完整自述文件的 Github 存储库：https://github.com/DJ-Tribefull/Comfyui_FOCUS_nodes

o.en:
• A perfected two-stage SDXL workflow. Leverages wildcards to generate a truly endless variety of portraits with a single click.

  • Crispy-clean andcompactlayout! Everything important is visible and accessible on a single screen.

  • 21 second upscaled output on an RTX 4080.

  • FOCUS Nodes required. (Available in ComfyUI Manager). Wildcard files are built-in and ready to go.

  • If you don't want to mess around with installing the requirements for the face-detailer setup, just delete the nodes and reattach links where needed. The detailer is only important when using specific checkpoint combinations, and doesn't do much with my default settings.

  • Github repo with full readme:https://github.com/DJ-Tribefull/Comfyui_FOCUS_nodes
